t2i_prompt: Flat desktop UI mockup, no device frame, of a first-screen hero for <CONTENT>. Warm off-white limestone background. Left: a very large three-line headline mixing thin light numerals with heavy uppercase words, a short paragraph, a square steel-blue button and an arrow text link. Right: a tall fine-line plotter drawing of an abstract recirculating loop made of concentric nested hairlines with flow arrows, small inline component symbols, leader-line callouts with mono values, a vertical tick ruler and x-y axes. Deep navy and steel-blue lines only, flat vector, no shadows, generous negative space, a phone view beside it.
signature_idea: Purity shown as a plotted measurement: the water loop drawn as concentric hairlines inside a ruler and axes, with the limit values called out.
strengths: calm, high-end first impression without stock photography
drawing ties to a real Aquemi asset (the distribution loop)
callouts with real units signal precision to engineers
light numerals echo Geist light plus mono figures
weaknesses: '99.9999% pure' style claim is hype the brand voice avoids
heavy caps on the claim words still overweight
loop drawing is abstract enough to read as a logo or racetrack
mobile frame has rounded corners, off the square-corner rule
brand_fit_why: Limestone, navy, one steel-blue accent, fine lines and generous space fit; the heavy caps half of the headline and the hype figure do not.
